target.title: fix: prune stale tool results on direct OpenAI models
target.body:
Closes #95840

AI-assisted: yes.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who enable `contextPruning.mode: "cache-ttl"` on direct OpenAI models would never get the idle-gap tool-result pruning firebreak, even though OpenAI prompt caching can reuse stable prompt prefixes.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix separates explicit cache-control eligibility from cache-TTL context-pruning eligibility. OpenAI stays ineligible for Anthropic-style cache-control injection, while direct `openai` models can now enable the context-pruning extension and write the per-attempt cache-TTL marker used to time pruning.

Docs now call out that direct OpenAI pruning uses OpenAI's automatic prompt-cache path and does not create Anthropic `cache_control` blocks or manage an OpenAI cache resource.

## User Impact

Users running long OpenAI-backed sessions can configure cache-TTL pruning to trim stale tool results after idle gaps, reducing context bloat without changing persisted transcript history or OpenAI request payload cache-control semantics.

## Evidence

- `pnpm docs:list`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/cache-ttl.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/extensions.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.spawn-workspace.cache-ttl.test.ts` - 3 files, 22 tests passed
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/format-docs.mjs --check` - Docs formatting clean (685 files)
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` - clean, no accepted/actionable findings

Proof gap: remote Testbox-through-Crabbox validation is blocked in this checkout because `../crabbox/bin/crabbox` is missing, `crabbox` is not on PATH, and `node scripts/crabbox-wrapper.mjs ...` fails its basic binary sanity check before allocation.
